name: com.adrimg.holotable
description: Mixed-reality tabletop framework: physical Pokémon TCG cards, Magic: The Gathering cards and Warhammer 40K miniatures come alive as animated 3D holograms (Yu-Gi-Oh style). Tested rules engine, SDK-agnostic tracking (AR Foundation, Vuforia, custom), combat choreography, AR dice, and a desktop simulator to play without AR hardware.

samples.description: Sample card data for all three games (Charmander→Charizard, Pikachu, energies, Shivan Dragon, Serra Angel, Lightning Bolt, Intercessor, Ork Boy, Terminator…) and a master catalog. Used by HoloTable ▸ Create Demo Scene.
